title: variantalker pipeline parameters
description: variantalker enables users to annotate variants starting from VCF files

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 4 columns, and a header row. See [usage docs](https://github.com/zhanyinx/variantalker#input-format).

clonal_tmb_input.description: Path to comma-separated input file for biomarkers containing information about the samples in the experiment.
clonal_tmb_input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 8 columns, and a header row. See [usage docs](https://github.com/zhanyinx/clonal_evolution#input).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

fasta.help_text: This parameter is *mandatory* if `--genome` is not specified.

build.description: Build of the genome, e.g. hg19, hg38
build.help_text: Build of the genome, e.g. hg19, hg38

target.description: Path to exome capture bed file.
target.help_text: Provide the bed file with region covered by WES. If WGS, put full chromosome size file with chr, start end

max_job_request_options.title: Max job request options
max_job_request_options.description: Set the top limit for requested resources for any single job.
max_job_request_options.help_text:
If you are running on a smaller system, a pipeline step requesting more resources than are available may cause the Nextflow to stop the run with an error. These options allow you to cap the maximum resources requested by any single job so that the pipeline will run on your system.

Note that you can not _increase_ the resources requested by any job using these options. For that you will need your own configuration file. See [the nf-core website](https://nf-co.re/usage/configuration) for details.

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs that can be requested for any single job.
max_cpus.help_text: Use to set an upper-limit for the CPU requirement for each process. Should be an integer e.g. `--max_cpus 1`

max_memory.description: Maximum amount of memory that can be requested for any single job.
max_memory.help_text: Use to set an upper-limit for the memory requirement for each process. Should be a string in the format integer-unit e.g. `--max_memory '8.GB'`

max_time.description: Maximum amount of time that can be requested for any single job.
max_time.help_text: Use to set an upper-limit for the time requirement for each process. Should be a string in the format integer-unit e.g. `--max_time '2.h'`

databases.title: Public databases to use
databases.help_text: Updated public databases are essential for proper functional annotations. Update frequently your databases.

annovar_db.description: Path to the folder containing annovar databases, e.g. humandb

funcotator_germline_db.description: Path to the folder containing funcotator germline databases. e.g. funcotator_dataSources.v1.7.20200521g

funcotator_somatic_db.description: Path to the folder containing funcotator somatic databases. e.g. funcotator_dataSources.v1.7.20200521s

funcotator_target.description: target file for funcotator. Keep it null if variant calling has been done with target file.

funcotator_ncores.description: number of cores to use for funcotator annotation. If you have a lot of variants, you can increase this number to speed up the annotation. If you have a small number of variants, you can decrease this number to save resources. Note that this is not the number of cores used for the whole pipeline, but only for the funcotator annotation step. The pipeline will automatically split the variants into chunks and run them in parallel.

target_padding.description: Padding of the target region to avoid problems with 0 or 1 starting bins

splice_site_window_size.description: Number of bases on either side of a splice site for a variant to be classified as a SPLICE_SITE variant

transcript_list.description: file with the list of transcripts. This list must match the ensembl transcript id in gencode source file provided to funcotator.

database_dir.description: Base folder of all database files
database_dir.help_text: Path to the folder with all database files. e.g. path to the downloaded public_databases.

civic_cache_timeout_days.description: Set to 0 if you want to get the latest version of the civic db. Current is updated Dec. 18th 2024
civic_cache_timeout_days.help_text: Number of days for cache timeout in civic. Current version is from Dec. 18th 2024.

escat_db.help_text: File to the escat database. Default provided in the resource directory in the repo

nmd_db.help_text: File to the nmd database. Default provided in the resource directory in the repo

alpha_missense.description: File to the alpha missense database
alpha_missense.help_text: File to the alpha missense database. Default provided in the resource directory in the repo

filtering.title: Filters applied to variant
filtering.description: Filters applied to variant to be kept in the filtered file
filtering.help_text: Filters applied to variant to be kept in the filtered file

filter_alpha_missense.description: comma separated list of alpha missense classes to keep. Available values: likely_pathogenic,ambiguous,likely_benign

filter_min_depth.description: min depth to keep variant in the filtered output file

filter_vaf_threshold.description: min somatic variant allele frequency to keep the variant in the filtered variant output file

filter_vaf_threshold_germline.description: min germline variant allele frequency to keep the variant in the filtered variant output file

filter_clinvar.description: comma separated list of clinvar classes to keep. Available values: Pathogenic, Likely_pathogenic, Uncertain_significance, Conflicting_classifications_of_pathogenicity, Likely_benign, Benign, drug_response, not_provided, , no_classifications_from_unflagged_records, risk_factor, Affects, no_classification_for_the_single_variant, association, other, Uncertain_risk_allele, Likely_risk_allele, _low_penetrance, protective, association_not_found, Established_risk_allele, confers_sensitivity

filter_escat.description: comma separated list of escat classes to keep. Available values: IA, IB, IC, IIA, IIB, IIIA, IIIB, V

filter_intervar.description: comma separated list of intervar classes to keep. Available values: Pathogenic,Likely pathogenic,Uncertain significance,Likely benign,Benign

filter_cancervar.description: comma separated list of cancervar classes to keep. Available values: Tier_II_potential,Tier_I_strong,Tier_III_Uncertain,Tier_IV_benign

filter_civic_evidence_level.description: comma separated list of civic evidence level to keep to keep. Available values: A,B,C,D,E

filter_renovo.description: comma separated list of renovo classes to keep. Available values: LP Pathogenic,IP Pathogenic,HP Pathogenic,LP Benign,IP Benign,HP Benign

filter_genes_somatic.description: file with list of Hugo_Symbol genes to be kept

filter_genes_germline.description: file with list of Hugo_Symbol genes to be kept

skip_pathogenic_retention.description: Skip automatic retention of pathogenic variants

filter_var_classification.description: Filter on variant classification. Available options can be found in Variant Classification here: https://gatk.broadinstitute.org/hc/en-us/articles/360035531732-Funcotator-Annotation-Specifications

db.title: Database with annotated variant
db.description: Database configuration for caching annotated variants
db.help_text: Configure either SQLite (deprecated) or PostgreSQL database for storing and reusing variant annotations

sqlite_db_dir.description: Path to sqlite databases folder (DEPRECATED - use PostgreSQL instead)

pg_dsn.help_text: Complete PostgreSQL connection string. If provided, overrides pg_host/pg_user/pg_port/pg_password.

pg_host.help_text: PostgreSQL server hostname or IP address

pg_database.help_text: Name of the PostgreSQL database to use for annotation caching

technology.description: Technology used to generate data within database. E.g. illumina, iontorrent
technology.help_text: Technology used to generate data within database. E.g. illumina, iontorrent

annovar_version.description: Version of annovar used to annotate the variants

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options let you customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

tracedir.description: Directory to keep pipeline Nextflow logs and reports.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

show_hidden_params.help_text: By default, parameters set as _hidden_ in the schema are not shown on the command line when a user runs with `--help`. Specifying this option will tell the pipeline to show all parameters.

pipeline.description: Pipeline from which VCF has been generated: DRAGEN, sarek or iontorrent supported.

projectid.description: The project the VCF sample belongs to. Used to add column to maf file so that VCF from sample projects have the same projectid

analysis.description: Type of analysis to do: annotation (default), biomarkers (beta version)

cnvkit_threshold.description: Hard thresholds for calling each integer copy number, separated by commas

intervar_evidence_file.description: Evidence file for InterVar, default null

cancervar_evidence_file.description: Evidence file for CancerVar, default null

cnvkit_cellularity.description: Tumor purity used to call interger copy number in cnvkit

annovar_software_folder.description: Path to the folder containing annovar software

chunk_size.description: Number of variants to process in a single chunk

ascat_min_base_qual.description: Overwrite Ascat min base quality required for a read to be counted.

ascat_min_counts.description: Overwrite Ascat minimum depth required in the normal for a SNP to be considered.

ascat_min_map_qual.description: Overwrite Ascat min mapping quality required for a read to be counted.

ascat_ploidy.help_text: ASCAT: optional argument to override ASCAT optimization and supply psi parameter (expert parameter, don’t adapt unless you know what you’re doing). See [here](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VanLoo-lab/ascat/master/man/ASCAT-manual.pdf)

ascat_alleles.description: Reference allele frequencies for SNP loci derived from the 1000 Genomes Project, used to estimate B-allele frequencies (BAF).

ascat_loci.description: Genomic positions of SNP loci from the 1000 Genomes Project, defining the set of markers used in ASCAT analysis.

ascat_loci_gc.description: GC content annotation for each SNP locus, used to correct coverage biases related to GC content.

ascat_loci_rt.description: Replication timing annotation for SNP loci, used to adjust for coverage biases associated with DNA replication timing.

cosmic_group.description: Overwrites the group file provided by default.
cosmic_group.help_text: Group file with two columns: grouping column and the correpsonding sbs.

cosmic_version.description: Version of cosmic SBS database. Currently, with the version of sigprofilerassignment, the latest is 3.4

exome.description: Set to true if exome sequencing data is used, false if whole genome sequencing data is used.
exome.help_text: Set to true if exome sequencing data is used, false if whole genome sequencing data is used.

cnv_genes_keep.description: file with list of Hugo_Symbol genes to be kept for CNV

pharmgkb_hg38_fasta.description: Reference fasta for hg38 pharmgkb annotation

pharmgkb_hg38_chain.description: Chain file for hg19 to hg38 liftover
